title: South Australian Museum

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified Terrarium ground at the center of the mapped museum envelope.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap named South Australian Museum building
mapIdentity.scope: The named South Australian Museum building, OpenStreetMap way 185409279, preserves the 19-node envelope and entry setbacks. The south facing East Wing fixes the axis. The Mortlock Wing, Art Gallery, former Armoury and former Mounted Police Barracks are neighboring buildings with their own mapped identities.

note: The dated public-domain completed East Wing negative shows the courtyard tower, slate hips, long raised roof lantern, semicircular sandstone openings and coursed plinth. The cleared Qualla courtyard photograph and city heritage record show the modern stepped glazing and the red-brick North Wing with its low lantern.
